verdict.rationale: Treg is open source and self-hostable, and a community user reports running it with one click. That gives an exit path away from the hosted treg.to service and limits lock-in. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to export your account data, such as team tool configurations, shared credentials, call history, reviews or billing usage, in any format. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature, open or standard export formats, a path to migrate hosted data into a self-hosted instance, and independent confirmation of a clean exit.
